title: Sample AWS flag pack
description: A minimal, genuinely deployable sample: one AWS/CloudFormation Challenge that stands up a single SSM Parameter holding a per-deploy random flag (TC{...}) plus a least-privilege ParticipantViewerRole so a competitor can read it. Zero-cost (SSM Standard tier; no EC2 / VPC / public endpoint). The simplest end-to-end deploy -> flag -> score example.
